typical_fields_rule: largest, then 75th/50th/25th percentile by labelled pixels (render_sickle_gallery)
failing_fields_rule: mean field IoU over completed seeds < 0.5 (as the manuscript)
chip_rule: (a) the field's chip with the most labelled pixels; (b) the chip with the most wrong pixels at seed 0; both cropped to the field plus margin (14-32 px)
